THE HON'BLE MR JUSTICE MOHAMMAD NAWAZ  ORAL ORDER
This is a successive bail petition preferred by the sole accused in Crime No.145/2022 of Chikodi Police Station, Belagavi District.

2. Charge sheet is filed against the accused for offences punishable under Section 363, 376 (2) (i) (n)
of IPC and under Section 4 and 6 of POCSO Act, 2012.

3. Petitioner had preferred Crl.P.No.100046/2023 before this Court seeking bail and the said petition was permitted to be withdrawn with liberty to the petitioner to file a fresh petition before the Sessions Court, after the evidence of victim girl is recorded.

No such petition has NC:
2024:KHC-D:16492 been filed before the Sessions Court, subsequent to the evidence of the victim is recorded.
Copy of the deposition of the victim is also not furnished.

4. In view of the specific order passed by this Court in the above petition, disposed of on 01.02.2023,
it is open for the petitioner to file a fresh petition before the Sessions Court, since the evidence of the victim has been recorded now.
5. If any such petition is filed, the learned Sessions Judge shall dispose of the same as expeditiously as possible, considering that the petitioner is in judicial custody since 02.07.2022.
6. The certified copies of the documents furnished along with this petition may be returned to the learned counsel for the petitioner, at his request and on filing a memo.
